source_title: Manchester United miss chance to close on WSL top three in drab draw at Everton
source_excerpt:
A group of well-choreographed, fancy-dress-wearing school-age dancers fully embraced the Halloween spirit on Saturday as they boogied to one of Michael Jackson’s greatest hits at half-time here. Alas, the match itself was no thriller.
For Manchester United, the only scary thing about this game was how little they tested Courtney Brosnan in Everton’s goal in the first 75 minutes as they demonstrated their lack of creativity.
Brosnan did well to save from Elisabeth Terland’s strike, as United grew into the game late on and began to apply some pressure, but this was a fixture worthy of finishing goalless or – as Sky Sports put it – ghoul-less.
Terland has scored five Women’s Super League goals against Everton, but Brosnan was equal to her close-range shot after Jess Park’s through ball.
“It was not a good performance, but we aren’t always going to perform amazing or good,” said the Manchester United head coach, Eva Olid. “But it’s [about] always finding a way to win and today we didn’t.
“We need to be better. Out of possession, we were late, jumping late, to the individual duels, and in-possession we missed that creativity or connections we were having in the last matches.”
Everton, who are winless in all 15 WSL meetings with United, will be the happier with the point, and their encouraging performance, but they missed the opportunity to climb above their opponents into fourth and might wish they could have converted some of their good midfield play.
Their former Manchester United full-back Hannah Blundell hooked a dangerous effort, left-footed, towards the top corner in the first half, but her shot was saved by Phallon Tullis-Joyce, who also held on to shots – directed straight at her – from Ornella Vignola either side of the break.
Rosa van Gool and Yuka Momiki were combining well for Everton in midfield to frustrate United. United had won away at Everton in the past four seasons, but they were second best in the first half and unable to break the deadlock in the closing stages, despite making improvements after Simi Awujo came on.
United have been on a positive run, winning three and drawing one of their previous four WSL m atches, the derby against Manchester City through a morale-boosting late equaliser, as well as enjoying a 100% record in the Players Cup, but they were stifled by an Everton side whose midfield kept the ball well.
Olid, who took over from Marc Skinner in August, said: “After such a positive performance on Sunday [against City] there is always that question – [are we] going to keep that standard or are we going to go a little down, like a hangover after that good match? I expected we would be better than we were. If this has to happen for us to learn and improve, we are going to do that.”
A Park effort sailed high over the bar, after an Andrea Medina shot was blocked inside the Everton area, but otherwise there was relatively little to note of United’s first hour, from an attacking perspective.
This was Everton’s first draw of the league campaign, after three wins and four defeats, and they climbed above Arsenal – who play on Sunday – into sixth. They remain two points behind United, as Scott Phelan continues to oversee a steady – if unspectacular – spell in charge.
The Everton head coach said: “In the first half, I thought we were competitive, we showed some good bits with the ball. We just probably lacked a little bit of end product and belief in our game to finish the good passages of play we had. Second half, not so much, but it did highlight the togetherness of the team and the defensive organisation.”
His team certainly did look defensively well-organised. All they were really lacking was a top-quality focal point in attack, in a wretched game that did little to generate suspense.

## वीमेंस सुपर लीग का मुकाबला

हाल ही में खेले गए वीमेंस सुपर लीग (WSL) मुकाबले में मैनचेस्टर यूनाइटेड और एवर्टन का मैच बिना किसी गोल के बराबरी पर समाप्त हुआ। इस मुकाबले में दोनों टीमों के बीच संघर्ष देखने को मिला, लेकिन कोई भी टीम गोल करने में सफल नहीं हो पाई।

## मैच के मुख्य बिंदु

* **रचनात्मकता की कमी:** मैनचेस्टर यूनाइटेड की टीम मैच के अधिकांश समय में अपनी लय हासिल करने के लिए जूझती नजर आई और एवर्टन की गोलकीपर कोर्टनी ब्रॉसनन को शुरुआती 75 मिनट तक ज्यादा परेशान नहीं कर सकी।
* **एवर्टन का प्रदर्शन:** एवर्टन की मिडफील्ड ने अच्छा खेल दिखाया और गेंद पर नियंत्रण रखते हुए यूनाइटेड के आक्रमण को रोकने में सफलता हासिल की। 
* **अंतिम समय के प्रयास:** मैच के अंतिम क्षणों में मैनचेस्टर यूनाइटेड ने कुछ दबाव बनाया और एलिसा टेरलैंड ने गोल करने का प्रयास किया, जिसे ब्रॉसनन ने असफल कर दिया। वहीं एवर्टन की ओर से हन्ना ब्लंडेल और ओर्नेला विग्नोला ने भी प्रयास किए, जिन्हें यूनाइटेड की गोलकीपर फालोन टुलिस-जॉयस ने सुरक्षित अपने कब्जे में ले लिया।

## कोच की प्रतिक्रियाएं

मैनचेस्टर यूनाइटेड की मुख्य कोच ईवा ओलिद ने मैच के बाद स्वीकार किया कि टीम का प्रदर्शन अच्छा नहीं था। उन्होंने कहा कि टीम गेंद के साथ अपनी रचनात्मकता और आपसी तालमेल से चूक गई। वहीं, एवर्टन के कोच स्कॉट फेलन ने टीम की रक्षात्मक संगठित शैली और एकजुटता की सराहना की, हालांकि उन्होंने माना कि टीम अपने अच्छे हमलों को गोल में बदलने के लिए आवश्यक फिनिशिंग से चूक गई।

इस परिणाम के बाद एवर्टन तालिका में छठे स्थान पर पहुंच गया है, जबकि मैनचेस्टर यूनाइटेड शीर्ष तीन के करीब पहुंचने का अवसर चूक गई।

## स्थिति की पुष्टि कैसे करें

इस मैच की आधिकारिक रिपोर्ट और स्कोरकार्ड की पुष्टि के लिए वीमेंस सुपर लीग (WSL) की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट या संबंधित खेल समाचार पोर्टल्स के परिणामों को देखा जा सकता है।

en_body:
Manchester United missed an opportunity to close the gap on the Women's Super League top three following a goalless draw against Everton. The match, which featured limited attacking fluency from both sides, left United unable to break down a well-organized Everton defense.

## Match Overview

* **Final Score:** Everton 0, Manchester United 0
* **Standings Impact:** Everton moved into sixth place in the league table following their first draw of the campaign, remaining two points behind Manchester United.
* **Key Chances:** Everton's Hannah Blundell forced a first-half save from Phallon Tullis-Joyce, while United's best late opening fell to Elisabeth Terland, whose close-range effort was stopped by Everton goalkeeper Courtney Brosnan.

## Manager Reaction

Manchester United head coach Eva Olid acknowledged the shortcomings in her team's performance, pointing to a lack of creativity in possession and tardiness in individual duels out of possession. Olid noted that the squad failed to replicate the standards shown in their previous outing against Manchester City.

Everton head coach Scott Phelan praised his side's first-half competitiveness and defensive organization, though he conceded that the team lacked a clinical end product in the final third.

## Practical Implications

* Manchester United failed to capitalize on the chance to secure ground in the upper tier of the WSL standings.
* Everton extended their defensive resilience under Phelan, securing a point that lifts them above Arsenal pending Sunday's fixtures.

To verify official match details, starting lineups, and league standings, supporters can consult the official Women's Super League website or the club channels of both Manchester United and Everton.
